title: West Bengal Budget Highlights: 1 lakh vacancies in govt jobs to be filled, ₹36,000 cr for Annapurna scheme; ₹14,000 cr for GRAMG scheme; 20% DA hike and more
description: The BJP government in West Bengal on Monday presented its maiden budget, announcing the filling of 1 lakh government vacancies, a 20 percentage point hike in DA for its employees, and a Rs 36,000-crore outlay for the financial assistance scheme for women, Annapurna Yojana
